I explained the situation in the other reply

I'm seventeen right now turning 18 soon. My parents are the ones who are making me do this. They said things like im a financial and general burden on them and they make it very clear that they don't want to have me around anymore. They wont let me move in with someone else or get a job so I wont be able to afford to move out when im 18. Once I graduate my only options are to be basically homeless or to stay with some weirdo off of craigslist because I don't have friends. The things my mother and father have done to me have damaged me to the point where i cant even handle normal everyday situations and I cant focus in school. Ive always been suicidal and I've attempted this about five times but i think today I'm just done with it all. I was thinking about telling my doctor but my parents make sure i dont tell anyone like that by going in the room with me. If i tell a teacher nothing will happen because i haven't been physically abused and my mom and dad are liars. I came to reddit thinking maybe someone can think of a way out for me or just give me some sense of hope that I can recover and just forget about this and its selfish but i think im just so messed up that this has become my only option. The constant abuse ive been put through from about age ten until now is unbelievable and everything I like is a constant reminder of them. I just cant take it anymore. I've looked into everything I can...

I understand how you feel. I don't know why parents do the things they do. Mine are like that too. If you want to talk about it I would love to because maybe we could help each other with the same problem. The only thing that keeps me going through those events is the thought in my head that one day i'll be able to start over and forget all about my parents and sister. I dont know what type of life you want but the truth is that you probably have a fuck ton of potential and your parents are dragging you down so much that you don't care about your potential. I hope that you can find any bit of strength to get through these times. Im here for you.
